package student

import (
	"context"
	"testing"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
)

type planningReadinessReaderStub struct {
	source domain.StudentPlanningReadinessSource
	calls  int
}

func (stub *planningReadinessReaderStub) ReadPlanningReadiness(_ context.Context, studentID string) (domain.StudentPlanningReadinessSource, error) {
	stub.calls++
	stub.source.StudentID = studentID
	return stub.source, nil
}

func TestGetStudentPlanningReadinessUsesOneReadPortAndRejectsInvalidID(t *testing.T) {
	reader := &planningReadinessReaderStub{}
	useCase := GetStudentPlanningReadiness{Reader: reader}
	if _, err := useCase.Handle(context.Background(), "bad"); err != domain.ErrValidation || reader.calls != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("invalid err=%v calls=%d", err, reader.calls)
	}
	result, err := useCase.Handle(context.Background(), "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111")
	if err != nil || reader.calls != 1 || result.StateRef.Kind != "none" {
		t.Fatalf("result=%+v err=%v calls=%d", result, err, reader.calls)
	}
}
